subject.title: [Bug]: Gateway hard-crashes with 0xC0000409 (STATUS_STACK_BUFFER_OVERRUN) on Windows during Mattermost streaming reply; auto-respawn frequently wedges

question: Should investigation require a current Windows fatal report that distinguishes the libuv process-title assertion from Mattermost/Ollama runtime failure before accepting a fix direction?
rationale: The same Windows exit code has a credible upstream explanation, but the issue combines three possible roots—process title, streaming runtime, and restart recovery—and source inspection alone cannot safely select one.

options.title: Require discriminating fatal proof
options.body: Capture current-release Node fatal-report output and a foreground-versus-scheduled-task comparison before approving code changes.

options.title: Apply a defensive Windows title guard
options.body: Skip command-specific process-title assignment on affected Windows runtimes while retaining the issue for confirmation of the Mattermost and restart symptoms.

options.title: Split the investigation
options.body: Track the process-title crash and post-respawn wedge as separate issues, preserving this report as the evidence umbrella until both are classified.

recommendation.title: Require discriminating fatal proof
recommendation.body: Capture current-release Node fatal-report output and a foreground-versus-scheduled-task comparison before approving code changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this owner to the Mattermost merge/hardening and adjacent Windows runtime behavior, making them the best routing candidate for selecting investigation scope.
